title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
description: p We are hiring strong 2026 and 2027 Graduate Software Engineers /strong into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code. /p p If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here. /p p Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday. /p p We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit. /p p If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career. /p p strong Location: /strong This is a Globally remote role. /p h3 The role entails /h3 ul li Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months /li li Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps /li li Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users /li li Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge /li li Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers /li li Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements /li li Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation /li /ul h3 What we are looking for in you /h3 ul li Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university /li li Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses /li li Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java /li li Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution /li li Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results /li li Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments /li li Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum /li li Professional written and spoken English /li li Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability /li li Personal responsibility and accountability /li li Thoughtfulness, self-awareness and the ability to reflect and develop /li li Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long /li /ul h3 Nice-to-have skills /h3 ul li Upstream open source contributions /li li Packaging and Linux distribution contributions - Debian, Fedora, Arch, Nix or another /li li Leadership and organization skills /li li Presentation and writing skills /li li Business and commercial interests /li /ul h3 What we offer colleagues /h3 p We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. title: Senior AI Specialist
description: div class= content-intro p strong About Coursera + Udemy /strong /p p Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our nbsp; a href= https://blog.coursera.org/coursera-and-udemy-are-now-one-company-creating-the-worlds-most-comprehensive-skills-platform/ target= _blank blog /a . /p p strong Why join us now? /strong /p p AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. /p p strong Shape what comes next /strong /p p By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. /p /div h3 Job Overview /h3 p Coursera is seeking a Senior AI Specialist to own the technical design and delivery of complex AI applications for business and customer needs. You’ll turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions, working across data exploration, experimentation, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment. This is a hands-on senior IC role: you’ll lead architectural decisions independently, build critical components, and resolve difficult problems across models, agents, applications, and data. You’ll partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, LLMOps, and forward-deployed teams to deliver solutions within enterprise and customer environments. Your work will establish reusable approaches and technical standards that improve AI quality, reliability, security, and delivery across projects. /p p About your skills: /p p strong AI Systems Architecture /strong — Design end-to-end applied AI solutions, combining models, retrieval, agentic workflows, and application services while balancing quality, scalability, security, and cost. br strong AI Delivery amp; Reliability /strong — Build production grade AI components and reliable data workflows, integrating enterprise data, models, and tools into tested, maintainable applications. Define how AI quality is measured and monitored, using evaluation frameworks, agent tracing strong br /strong strong Technical Leadership /strong — Own complex technical decisions, lead design and code reviews, AI evals, and guide cross-functional teams from experimentation through validated production deployment. /p h3 What you'll be doing /h3 ul li strong Own AI solution architecture /strong - Translate ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, service boundaries, data contracts, and implementation plans. Lead build v/s buy decisions and document trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, security, and cost. /li li strong Architect RAG systems. /strong Design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using vector databases, sparse and dense retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and reranking. Define document parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing strategies. nbsp; /li li strong Evaluate and fine-tune models /strong . Determine when model adaptation is warranted over prompting or retrieval. Curate training and validation datasets, implement supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA, and benchmark against baseline models for task accuracy, safety, latency, and cost. nbsp; /li li strong Develop AI services and data integrations. /strong Build critical Python/TypeScript services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and indexing pipelines, including normalization of customer data, schema validation, incremental updates, lineage, and recovery. /li li strong Build enterprise agentic systems. /strong Develop stateful workflows with task decomposition, planning, multi-step tool use, dynamic tool selection, structured outputs, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration where justified. Build tool and MCP integrations with validated inputs, scoped permissions, and human approval for sensitive actions. Evaluate retrieval and agent quality against strong defined accuracy and grounding metrics /strong . /li li strong Implement AI security, and governance controls. /strong Implement defenses against prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and retrieval access violations. Contribute threat models, adversarial tests, and evidence for governance reviews. Translate centrally defined policies into application controls for identity, tenant isolation, data residency, retention, and auditability. nbsp; /li li strong Adapt solutions to enterprise environments. /strong Work with Engineering and forward-deployed teams to implement cloud, hybrid, and customer-controlled deployments. /li li strong AI evaluation and production observability. /strong Define evaluation datasets and measure retrieval quality, groundedness, task completion, tool correctness, latency, and cost. Combine deterministic checks, calibrated LLM-as-judge, and human review. Partner with LLMOps on CI/CD release gates, prompt and model versioning, tracing, and safe rollouts and rollbacks. /li li strong Own technical quality and system reliability. /strong Set and enforce quality standards across the team, with accountability for code quality, maintainability, and production reliability.
